scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:react && npm run build:standalone && npm run build:collab
scripts.test: npm run test -w system-canvas-react && npm run test -w system-canvas-collab
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w system-canvas && npm run typecheck -w system-canvas-react && npm run typecheck -w system-canvas-standalone && npm run typecheck -w system-canvas-collab && npm run typecheck -w system-canvas-demo
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && npm run sync-versions && git add -A && git commit -m "release: v$(node -p \"require('./package.json').version\")" && git push
scripts.release:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && npm run sync-versions && git add -A && git commit -m "release: v$(node -p \"require('./package.json').version\")" && git push
